#en: Oh. Small problem there... I think he only has the one ship.
zh: 哦。这儿有个小问题……我想他只有一艘船。

#en: I hate to deny treatment, but you don't have enough credits.
zh: 我不想拒绝治疗，但你的钱不够。

#en: I've already prepared a few of the Amps, ready for purchase.
zh: 我已经备好了几个增幅，可以购买。

#en: I've got some Amps already constructed if you're interested.
zh: 我有几个造好的增幅，感兴趣的话。

#en: There's nothing left to extract! At least, I don't think so.
zh: 没什么可提取的了！至少我觉得是这样。

#en: Here's a rundown on the Amps I may be able to get for you...
zh: 这是我可能帮你弄到的增幅清单……

#en: Those ships you flagged? Stripped and sold. Here's your cut.
zh: 你标记的那几艘船？拆了卖了。这是你的那份。

#en: You appear to have fitted the Skydrop to your personal ship.
zh: 你似乎把空投装到自己的飞船上了。

#en: Very well. Give me a moment to extract the necessary data...
zh: 很好。给我一点时间提取必要的数据……

#en: Only basic models, but still! Nothing to thumb your nose at!
zh: 只是基础型号，不过！也不容小觑！

#en: Let's jump to the Eridani system. Make orbit at Eridani III.
zh: 我们跃迁到波江座星系。在波江座III入轨。

#en: Breaker switches, now! The Corvette's gotta have more power!
zh: 快去扳开关！护卫舰需要更多电力！

#en: Perform a scan, I'll keep lookout for the Watchtower drones.
zh: 你来扫描，我盯着瞭望塔的无人机。

#en: Looks like you're there! Okay, here's what you need to do...
zh: 看来你到了！好，你需要这么做……

#en: You ready? We're going to Eridani III in the Eridani system.
zh: 准备好了吗？我们去波江座星系的波江座III。

#en: I don't want to be captured by Watchtower. Pants down or up.
zh: 我不想被瞭望塔抓住。横竖都不想。

#en: True enough. Still, it doesn't hurt to ponder their motives.
zh: 说得对。不过，琢磨一下他们的动机也没坏处。

#en: But I'd bet good credits, they're not after your average joe.
zh: 但我敢押上好信用点，他们找的不是普通人。

#en: I think we could accommodate that. Thanks for the help, Gren!
zh: 我想我们可以安排。谢谢帮忙，格伦！

#en: Oh. Small problem there... I think she only has the one ship.
zh: 哦。这儿有个小问题……我想她只有一艘船。

#en: Oof, you're not in good condition. We should start treatment.
zh: 哎哟，你状况不太好。我们该开始治疗了。

#en: Time for some core dissection, let's find the prize inside...
zh: 该解剖核心了，看看里面有什么好东西……

#en: But sacrifices are needed for the implants to work correctly.
zh: 但植入体要正常工作，就得有牺牲。

#en: I maintain a small stock of items. See what catches your eye.
zh: 我常备一些小货。看看有没有合眼的。

#en: Skydrop data extracted, I can now build it whenever you need.
zh: 空投数据已提取，你随时需要我都能造。

#en: Since you have no Skydrops built, shall we fabricate one now?
zh: 你还没造过空投，现在就造一个？

#en: Hm? Oh. Just someone I knew from Neon. His name's Shadowline.
zh: 嗯？哦。只是我在霓虹城认识的人。他叫暗影线。

#en: Huh... I hadn't thought of that. But I suppose it's possible!
zh: 哦……我没想到这点。不过我想有可能！

#en: You're lookin' a little rough around the edges. Need a drink?
zh: 你看起来有点憔悴。要来一杯吗？

#en: We got one! Intel shows a Listening Post in a far-off system.
zh: 找到了！情报显示遥远星系里有一处监听哨。

#en: Got it. This one's a hike, but we have a location for a Post.
zh: 明白了。这个有点远，但我们有了监听哨的位置。

#en: The mech's shields are too tough. You're wasting your energy!
zh: 机甲的护盾太硬。你在白费力气！

#en: Aha! There they are. Watchtower drones. Hmph. So predictable!
zh: 啊哈！它们在那儿。瞭望塔无人机。哼。真可预测！

#en: Get the scan started. I'll watch out for the incoming drones.
zh: 开始扫描。我盯着来的无人机。

#en: Hey, it's a plan that works! If it ain't broke, don't fix it!
zh: 嘿，管用就是好计划！没坏就别修！

#en: Alright. Remember! Watchtower's still looking to capture you.
zh: 好。记住！瞭望塔还在找你。

#en: Are we safe? Those drones didn't send out a signal, did they?
zh: 我们安全吗？那些无人机没发出信号吧？

#en: But first, we need to talk about the people who attacked you.
zh: 但首先，我们得谈谈袭击你的那伙人。

#en: Damn, we're tapped out on that, sorry! We'll have to restock.
zh: 该死，那个用完了，抱歉！得补货了。

#en: Unable to deploy, module is depleted. You'll need to restock.
zh: 无法部署，模块已耗尽。你需要补货。

#en: You, get back on your feet and meet me at Stardock. Alright?!
zh: 你，站起来，到星坞见我。明白了吗？！

#en: Good. Go ahead and "Commission" that ship, using the terminal.
zh: 好。用终端把那艘船「订造」吧。

#en: [Pay <Global=SQ_Doctors_Price_Wounds> Credits] Heal my wounds.
zh: [支付<Global=SQ_Doctors_Price_Wounds>信用点] 治疗我的伤口。

#en: Construction complete. Let me know when you want it installed.
zh: 建造完成。想安装时告诉我。

#en: What's your relationship with Torin? What do you think of him?
zh: 你和托林是什么关系？你觉得他怎么样？

#en: I'm curious about your past. Can you share some of it with me?
zh: 我对你的过去很好奇。能跟我讲讲吗？

#en: [Reasonably Safe] Somewhere that's calm, just a nice easy run.
zh: [相对安全] 找个平静的地方，轻松跑一趟就行。

#en: Alright, your nav's updated. You're good to go! Give 'em hell!
zh: 好，你的导航已更新。可以出发了！狠狠干他们！

#en: Oh, and that other slate? It also had a Post location on it...
zh: 哦，还有那块数据板？上面也有个监听哨位置……

#en: Head into the facility, and I'll join you as soon as I'm able!
zh: 进设施去，我尽量赶过去跟你会合！

#en: Get that flare on the target! Let's punch through and move in!
zh: 把信号弹打到目标上！我们破开进去！

#en: Head planet-side! I'll stick in orbit and get Skydrop prepped.
zh: 你去行星表面！我留在轨道准备空投。

#en: We getting the Control Node ourselves, or hiring the Advocate?
zh: 我们自己去取控制节点，还是雇辩护者？

#en: You so sure? I mean, here I am! And I don't seem to be dead...
zh: 你确定？你看，我在这儿呢！而且我好像没死……

#en: Maybe it has something to do with the facility we're going to?
zh: 也许跟我们要去的那座设施有关？

#en: Yeah, I remember. My head felt like it was splitting in two...
zh: 是啊，我记得。我头疼得像要裂成两半……

#en: I assist in docking, cargo and ship maintenance. I am B.A.B.S.
zh: 我负责对接、货物和飞船维护。我是 B.A.B.S.。

#en: That does sound bad! The Altair system is barely a jump away...
zh: 听起来确实不妙！牵牛星系也就一次跃迁的距离……

#en: Oh. Small problem there... I think they only have the one ship.
zh: 哦。这儿有个小问题……我想他们只有一艘船。

#en: Nothing I didn't anticipate. But I have had weeks to plan this.
zh: 都在我预料之中。但这事我计划了好几周。

#en: Feel free to browse, but no touching! Unless it's a Cyberamp...
zh: 随便看，但别碰！除非是赛博增幅……

#en: Neuroamp, Cyberamp, whatever it is, can't say I'm interested...
zh: 神经增幅器，赛博增幅，不管是什么，我都不太感兴趣……

#en: Ah, it's you. Shall I patch you up, or is this about Cyberamps?
zh: 啊，是你。要我给你治治，还是来问赛博增幅的？

#en: Study this, and you'll see what Amp blueprints we can expect...
zh: 看看这个，就知道能指望什么增幅图纸了……

#en: To avoid wasted resources, confirm this is your final decision.
zh: 为避免浪费资源，确认这是你的最终决定。

#en: It's ready. Skydrop fully functional and good for installation.
zh: 好了。空投功能完好，可以安装。

#en: All done. Let me know if you want this one mounted to a vessel.
zh: 完成了。想装到船上就告诉我。

#en: Before we proceed, would you like to fabricate a Skydrop first?
zh: 开始前，你想先造个空投吗？

#en: You'll find potential Skydrops listed here. Decide what's best.
zh: 这儿列出了可选空投。自己决定哪个最好。

#en: Acknowledged. I'll start once you confirm that's what you want.
zh: 收到。你确认要这个我就开始。

#en: [Deadly] Get me a system where survival is far from guaranteed.
zh: [致命] 给我找个生存毫无保障的星系。

#en: [Find Array] Can you find a Listening Post without using Intel?
zh: [寻找阵列] 你能不用情报找一个监听哨吗？

#en: All done. The Intel says there's a Post just around the corner.
zh: 好了。情报说拐角就有一处监听哨。

#en: One second. Just checking... Corvette's missing some systems...
zh: 等一下。我查查……护卫舰缺了几个系统……

#en: Let's deal with these drones, then head on down to the surface!
zh: 先收拾这些无人机，再下到地表！

#en: Run the scan! I'll keep an eye out for those Watchtower drones.
zh: 去扫描！我盯着那些瞭望塔无人机。

#en: Ready to leave for the Eridani system, or do you need a minute?
zh: 准备前往波江座星系，还是要再等一会儿？

#en: Please be advised: This unit does not possess combat protocols.
zh: 特此告知：本机不具备战斗协议。

#en: Negative. That Flare's in a bad spot. Reposition and try again.
zh: 不行。信号弹位置不好。换个位置再试。

#en: If you already trust me, then sure, you can trust her too! I do.
zh: 你都信我了，那当然也能信她！我信。

#en: Alright. Just don't make me regret letting you walk out of here.
zh: 好。别让我后悔放你走。

#en: My collection may not be vast, but what I do have is all useful.
zh: 我的收藏也许不算多，但每件都有用。

#en: My stock's limited, but every piece is worth its weight in gold.
zh: 我货不多，但每件都价值连城。

#en: I can extract more data to build a superior version of this Amp.
zh: 我可以提取更多数据，做出这个增幅的进阶版。

#en: Changed your mind, huh? That's fine. Just check the slate again.
zh: 改主意了，嗯？没关系。再看一遍数据板。

#en: Understood. Review the slate again, and tell me what to extract.
zh: 明白。再看一遍数据板，告诉我提取什么。

#en: Are you sure this is the Skydrop you want added to your arsenal?
zh: 你确定要把这个空投加入你的装备库？

#en: [Dangerous] I want some real stakes! I'm in the mood for danger.
zh: [危险] 我要真正的刺激！我就想冒点险。

#en: As an extra bonus, the other slate gave us an extra Post site...
zh: 另外，那块数据板还多给了我们一处监听哨……

#en: Finished. We got a post in a system not far off the beaten path.
zh: 完成了。我们在不太偏僻的星系找到了一处监听哨。

#en: That mech won't be a problem, unless we want it to be. Let's go!
zh: 那台机甲不成问题，除非我们想让它成。走吧！

#en: Almost there... but we're still short. One more, we're so close!
zh: 快了……但还是不够。再来一个，就差一点！

#en: Sorry, had to take the scenic route. But I'm here now! Let's go.
zh: 抱歉，绕了点远路。不过我到了！走吧。

#en: Throw a flare at the facility! Let's light it up and get inside!
zh: 朝设施扔个信号弹！点亮它，然后进去！

#en: We'll handle these drones, then make our descent to the surface.
zh: 我们收拾这些无人机，然后下降到地表。

#en: We've already done all this before, so let's get straight to it!
zh: 这些我们以前都做过，直接来吧！

#en: Ah, c'mon. I don't wanna ruin the surprise! That's half the fun!
zh: 啊，别嘛。我不想毁了惊喜！那才有一半的乐趣！

#en: Thanks for the introduction. Just don't expect the same from me.
zh: 谢谢介绍。不过别指望我也这样。

#en: Hey. We really need to talk about that group who attacked you...
zh: 嘿。我们真的得谈谈袭击你的那伙人……

#en: This isn't a social call. You're going to explain what happened.
zh: 这不是来串门。你得解释发生了什么。

#en: Unable to launch, drop zone obstructed. Adjust your positioning.
zh: 无法发射，投放区受阻。请调整位置。

#en: I'm an ally. Check your database, authorization 56K-PLACEHOLDER.
zh: 我是友方。查你的数据库，授权码 56K-PLACEHOLDER。

#en: Harper's got a soft spot for the dispossessed, that's for sure...
zh: 哈珀对无家可归的人确实心软，这点没错……

#en: Now then, Harper provided me with a "Watchtower Computer core"...
zh: 那么，哈珀给了我一块「瞭望塔计算机核心」……

#en: I've got everything I need. Your new Amp's ready for fabrication.
zh: 我需要的都齐了。你的新增幅可以制造了。

#en: I've got some inventory available. See if anything interests you.
zh: 我有些库存。看看有没有你感兴趣的。

#en: You'll need to source more credits before I can repair your ship.
zh: 你得先弄到更多钱，我才能修你的飞船。

#en: Finished. The Fleet Command System can now support one more ship.
zh: 完成。舰队指挥系统现在可再多支持一艘船。

#en: [Challenging] I don't mind some action, but nothing over the top.
zh: [挑战] 我不介意来点刺激，但别太过火。

#en: Transferring what we got now. Do what you gotta do! Safe travels.
zh: 把现有的传给你。该干什么干什么！一路平安。

#en: Got it! Looks like the Post is just a hop, skip, and a jump away.
zh: 好！看来监听哨就在不远处。

#en: Here goes! I'll go ready the Synapse Distuper. Get me that power!
zh: 开始了！我去准备突触干扰器。把电给我供上！

#en: I made sure the surprise mech is disabled again. Let's get going.
zh: 我确保那台惊喜机甲又瘫痪了。我们走吧。

#en: One of these days, maybe I'll make it sooner! Just not this time.
zh: 总有一天我会早点赶到！只是不是这次。

#en: This looks familiar. Reminds me of something from the Colony War.
zh: 这看着眼熟。让我想起殖民地大战时的东西。

#en: Leaving you absolutely helpless and at Watchtower's tender mercy!
zh: 让你彻底无助，任由瞭望塔发落！

#en: Vega II-c, I think. In the Vega system. Should be something there.
zh: 我想是织女星II-c。在织女星系。那儿应该有点东西。

#en: If you hand me the Control Node, we can begin building your fleet.
zh: 把控制节点交给我，我们就能开始组建你的舰队。

#en: And if you don't, you will soon enough! So why spoil the surprise?
zh: 就算你现在不知道，很快也会知道！何必剧透呢？

#en: Speaking of changing the subject, let me introduce my friend here!
zh: 说到换话题，我来介绍一下我这位朋友！

#en: My drop-in clinic is closed... But I suppose I can squeeze you in.
zh: 我的临时诊所已经关门了……不过我想可以挤个时间给你。

#en: Ahh... The data extracted perfectly, and I can now build this Amp.
zh: 啊……数据提取得很完美，我现在能造这个增幅了。

#en: Extraction successful. The Skydrop can now be installed to a ship.
zh: 提取成功。该空投现在可以安装到船上。

#en: Before modifying your ship, do you want to construct a Skydrop...?
zh: 改装飞船之前，你想先建造一个空投吗……？

#en: Hungry? Thirsty? Or just curious about what I've got stashed away?
zh: 饿了？渴了？还是好奇我藏了些什么？

#en: [Suicidal] Find me somewhere lethal. I either make it, or I don't.
zh: [自杀式] 给我找个要命的地方。要么活得下来，要么活不下来。

#en: Well, look who I caught up with! Miss me? Let's go find that Node!
zh: 瞧瞧我追上谁了！想我了吗？走，去找那个节点！

#en: So make your way inside the facility and I'll catch up when I can!
zh: 你先想办法进设施，我尽快赶过去！

#en: Hey! Saves us the effort, right? I'll go visit her usual haunts...
zh: 嘿！省了我们的力气，对吧？我去她常去的地方转转……

#en: I mentioned we're breaking into an old Watchtower facility, right?
zh: 我提过我们要闯一座旧的瞭望塔设施，对吧？

#en: You will submit. Please, don't make this harder than it has to be.
zh: 你会服从的。请别让事情变得更麻烦。

#en: Each one's probably got a nugget of info we can take for ourselves.
zh: 每一个大概都有点我们能拿走的情报。

#en: It's a delicate process, but I'll have your Amp ready in no time...
zh: 这过程很精细，不过你的增幅很快就好……

#en: Give this slate a look, and we'll figure out how best to proceed...
zh: 看看这块数据板，我们再决定怎么进行……

#en: Salvage operations went smoothly. Transferring you the credits now.
zh: 拆解作业很顺利。现在把钱转给你。

#en: All Skydrop modules are at full capacity. A restock is unnecessary.
zh: 所有空投模块都满载。无需补货。

#en: Almost every Watchtower member undergoes some kind of modification.
zh: 几乎每个瞭望塔成员都受过某种改造。

#en: Extraction complete. This Skydrop is now available for fabrication.
zh: 提取完成。该空投现在可以制造了。

#en: Of course. And you have at least one Skydrop module we can install.
zh: 当然。而且你至少有一个空投模块可以安装。

#en: You have a number of options. Review them and select what you want.
zh: 你有若干选项。看看，然后挑你想要的。

#en: Checked the second slate too. It had another Listening Post site...
zh: 我也查了第二块数据板。上面还有一处监听哨……

#en: No! Not at all! In fact, it's good to know you can still improvise.
zh: 不！完全没有！其实，知道你还善于随机应变是好事。

#en: Ohhh, no. No! No-no-no-no! Uh-uh. We are not-- This... This isn't--
zh: 哦，不。不！不不不不！不行。我们不是——这……这不是——

#en: We need the Fleet-Sync Control Node! I'll prep my ship and standby.
zh: 我们需要舰队同步控制节点！我准备好飞船待命。

#en: Hey, it wasn't through lack of trying! I looked everywhere I could.
zh: 嘿，我可不是没试过！我到处都找过了。

#en: So this "bonding", it worked? We'll always Unity jump together now?
zh: 所以这个「绑定」成功了？我们以后都会一起归一跳跃？

#en: This Fleet-Sync Control Node, this is what we came here for, right?
zh: 这个舰队同步控制节点，就是我们来这儿的目的，对吧？

#en: I imagine you've a lot of questions, and I do have answers for you!
zh: 我猜你有很多问题，而我确实有答案！

#en: My name is Torin. We can get more into who I am later, I promise...
zh: 我叫托林。我是谁以后再细说，我保证……

#en: First rule. This is my home, and you're a guest. So behave yourself!
zh: 第一条规矩。这是我的家，你是客人。所以守点规矩！

#en: I have a Skydrop ready for integration. Let's get it onto your ship.
zh: 我有一个空投可以整合。装到你的船上吧。

#en: And that's all you have to do. That vessel's now part of your fleet.
zh: 就这么简单。那艘船现在是你舰队的一员了。

#en: I mean exactly what I said. He's on our side. And I fully trust him.
zh: 我说的就是字面意思。他在我们这边。我完全信任他。

#en: Instead of waiting alone on an empty station, twiddling my thumbs...
zh: 与其在空荡的空间站里独自待着、无所事事……

#en: If you decide to extract something later, you know where to find me.
zh: 以后想提取什么，知道上哪儿找我。

#en: If you have any cores, I could always try to find you some new toys!
zh: 你要是还有核心，我说不定能给你弄点新玩具！

#en: Skim through my notes, and I'll see what we can pry from this one...
zh: 翻翻我的笔记，我看看这个能撬出什么……

#en: Are you positive? The fabrication will use up our limited materials.
zh: 你确定？制造会耗掉我们有限的材料。

#en: I want to upgrade the Fleet Command System, or maybe something else.
zh: 我想升级舰队指挥系统，或者别的什么。

#en: It was the only way I get it down on paper that this place was mine.
zh: 那是唯一能让我把「这地方是我的」写下来的方式。

#en: Still not done, the second slate also pointed to a Listening Post...
zh: 还没完，第二块数据板也指向一处监听哨……

#en: And... finished! There's a Post in a system within reasonable range.
zh: 然后……完成了！附近星系里有一处监听哨。

#en: You okay? Flip the breakers! The Disruptor's not gonna power itself!
zh: 你还好吗？去扳开关！干扰器可不会自己通电！

#en: No, it's gotta be something else. Something more... "unique"? Hm....
zh: 不，一定是别的。更……「独特」的东西？嗯……

#en: I know who Watchtower are. We were meant to have an understanding...
zh: 我知道瞭望塔是什么。我们本该有个默契……

#en: Another successful Unity jump together. Heh. Glad I'm still with ya.
zh: 又一次成功的共同归一跳跃。嘿。很高兴还在你身边。

#en: Gren's a cautious guy, always running scans! Likes to catalog things.
zh: 格伦是个谨慎的人，老是扫描！喜欢把东西分类记录。

#en: I'm no doctor, so I can't really explain the process in great detail.
zh: 我不是医生，没法详细解释这个过程。

#en: And their modifications are... extreme. Even by Watchtower standards.
zh: 而他们的改造……很极端。就算按瞭望塔的标准也是。

#en: A very cramped city. But, you learn to live with the confined spaces.
zh: 一座非常拥挤的城市。不过，你会习惯这些逼仄的空间。

#en: And as I'm sure you've noticed, I also have some cyberamps installed.
zh: 想必你也注意到了，我也装了赛博增幅。

#en: It's done, I secured the data, this Skydrop is now available for use.
zh: 完成了，数据已到手，这个空投现在可以用了。

#en: [10 Sentient AI Adapters, 10 Mech Parts] Skydrop - Bot Drop - AI Mech
zh: [10 感知人工智能适配器, 10 机甲零件] 空投 - 机器人空投 - AI机甲

#en: If Watchtower ever commercialized, they'd put Ryujin out of business!
zh: 瞭望塔要是商业化，龙神集团都得倒闭！

#en: [Tough] Find me somewhere I'll need to stay sharp to make it through.
zh: [艰难] 给我找个必须时刻警觉才能活下来的地方。

#en: Listening Post found! This one's not too close, but not too far away.
zh: 找到监听哨了！这个不远也不近。

#en: And I think with that out of the way, that's our cue to leave. C'mon!
zh: 这事解决了，我们该走了。来吧！

#en: ...Hah. Hey, you wanna see something cool? Fix your eyes on the mech.
zh: ……哈。嘿，想看点酷的吗？盯着那台机甲。

#en: Phew! Glad it was just drones. Okay then, let's get back to the plan.
zh: 呼！幸好只是无人机。那好，回到计划上。

#en: Try this on for size. Imagine you have a fleet of, like, seven ships.
zh: 你想想。假设你有一支舰队，大概七艘船。

#en: This seems important, but I can't help right now. I'll be back later.
zh: 这看起来很重要，但我现在帮不上。我晚点回来。

#en: Enough speculation. Only Watchtower really know why they're after me.
zh: 别猜了。只有瞭望塔真正知道为什么追我。

#en: Can't deploy. Interference detected. Throw a Flare somewhere clearer.
zh: 无法部署。检测到干扰。把信号弹扔到开阔些的地方。

#en: *crunch* Can drop whatever you need to make life easier. Get ready...
zh: *嘎吱* 你需要什么让日子好过点，我都能投。准备……

#en: *sigh* You know what, I'm not even going to say anything this time...
zh: *叹气* 这样吧，这次我干脆什么都不说了……

#en: Sooo, how did that little "doing this without me" go for you? Hmm...?
zh: 那么，那个「没我也能行」的结果怎么样？嗯……？

#en: Huh... Hair's a little shorter, I think. Eh, I dunno, hard to tell...
zh: 哦……头发好像短了点。唉，不知道，看不出来……

#en: At a guess, from Listening Posts, or the Arrays that keep 'em company.
zh: 我猜，是监听哨，或者跟它们配套的阵列。

#en: But per usual, yours truly was there to oh-so-heroically save the day!
zh: 但一如往常，本人在场，英勇地力挽狂澜！

#en: [Pay <Global=SQ_Doctors_Price_Addictions> Credits] Cure my addictions.
zh: [支付<Global=SQ_Doctors_Price_Addictions>信用点] 治好我的瘾。

#en: I've got all the Amps we've acquired so far, and a few extra things...
zh: 我们迄今弄到的增幅我这儿都有，还有几样别的东西……

#en: It's nice to meet you, doctor. I really appreciate you helping us out.
zh: 很高兴见到你，医生。非常感谢你帮我们。

#en: Then let's proceed. Don't forget, you've got a Skydrop we can install.
zh: 那就继续吧。别忘了，你有个空投可以安装。

#en: That's fine. The options remain the same, so what Skydrop do you want?
zh: 没关系。选项还是一样的，你要哪个空投？

#en: That mech's shields are holding strong. You can't damage it like that!
zh: 那台机甲的护盾很结实。那样伤不到它！

#en: Rise and shine. Did you have fun? Hah. Come on, then! Let's get going.
zh: 起床了。玩得开心吗？哈。那就来吧！我们走。

#en: Down to the planet's surface you go! I'll stay here and ready Skydrop.
zh: 你到行星表面去！我留在这儿准备空投。

#en: Uh... Well, actually, um, I-- I... you do. I mean, you did just ask...
zh: 呃……其实，嗯，我——我……你确实。我是说，你刚问了……

#en: But, I suspect that's something Watchtower wouldn't really care about.
zh: 但我怀疑瞭望塔根本不在乎这个。

#en: Oh, and next time? Send me a signal so I can come help your sorry ass.
zh: 哦，还有下次？给我发个信号，我好来救救你这可怜的家伙。

#en: Please, hand me the Control Node, and we can begin building your fleet.
zh: 请把控制节点给我，我们就能开始组建你的舰队。

#en: A thousand thank yous, my fair lady! Thy generosity is truly boundless!
zh: 万分感谢，我美丽的女士！你的慷慨真是无边无际！

#en: [Pay <Global=SQ_Doctors_Price_Everything> Credits] Take care of it all.
zh: [支付<Global=SQ_Doctors_Price_Everything>信用点] 全都处理了吧。

#en: Don't mind the mess. My last patient wasn't feeling, uh... cooperative.
zh: 别在意乱。我上一个病人不太……配合。

#en: All done! The data's extracted and your new Cyberamp is ready to build.
zh: 好了！数据已提取，你的新赛博增幅可以制造了。

#en: I stripped down that vessel you marked. Your account has been credited.
zh: 我把你标记的那艘船拆了。钱已记入你的账户。

#en: I speak of the parts that are essential for tech, such as the Skydrops.
zh: 我说的是技术必需的那些部件，比如空投。

#en: Your Skydrop inventory is already at full capacity. No resupply needed.
zh: 你的空投已满载。无需补货。

#en: *sigh* Regarding the organization as a whole, that's all I really know.
zh: *叹气* 关于整个组织，我知道的就这些。

#en: Didn't realize there would be a story. Let's talk about something else.
zh: 没想到还有故事。我们聊点别的吧。

#en: Upgrade successful. You'll find your fleet capacity has been increased.
zh: 升级成功。你的舰队容量已经提升。

#en: That's not all! The rest of the slates gave us more Post coordinates...
zh: 还不止！剩下的数据板给了我们更多监听哨坐标……

#en: Lining up for the hit. Make sure you're far enough away from that mech!
zh: 正在瞄准。确保你离那台机甲够远！

#en: Off you go to Eridani III's surface. I'll handle getting Skydrop ready.
zh: 你去波江座III的地表吧。空投的准备我来。

#en: Advocate's done her job. Control Node's in our hands and ready for use.
zh: 辩护者干完了活。控制节点已在我们手里，随时可用。

#en: ...Oh! I got an idea. Get some distance between you and that mech! Now!
zh: ……哦！我有主意了。离那台机甲远点！快！

#en: Visions, you say...? Well, that certainly sounds unique! But dangerous?
zh: 你说的是幻象……？嗯，听起来确实独特！但危险吗？

#en: Attention uncatalogued vessel. Our systems have flagged you as suspect.
zh: 注意，未登记飞船。我们的系统已将你标记为可疑目标。

#en: Find Listening Post, collect data, destroy vital infrastructure. Got it!
zh: 找监听哨，收集数据，摧毁关键设施。明白！

#en: Just keep your head down and don't get sloppy! No witnesses, no problem.
zh: 小心行事别马虎！没有目击者，就没问题。

#en: They'll know someone hit their Listening Post, sure! They're not idiots.
zh: 他们当然会知道有人端了他们的监听哨！他们又不是傻子。

#en: You told Torin about the Control Node? How'd you know where to find one?
zh: 你把控制节点的事告诉托林了？你怎么知道上哪儿找？

#en: However, a chance encounter -- forced me to reevaluate my career choice.
zh: 然而，一次偶遇——逼我重新考虑了自己的职业选择。

#en: [Pay <Global=SQ_Doctors_Price_Afflictions> Credits] Cure my afflictions.
zh: [支付<Global=SQ_Doctors_Price_Afflictions>信用点] 治好我的病痛。

#en: I can focus on upgrading this particular model, if that's what you need?
zh: 如果需要，我可以专门升级这个型号。

#en: This was in both the UC and Freestar Collective. As for House Va'ruun...
zh: 联殖和自由星系联盟都有。至于瓦鲁家族……

#en: There's nothing that needs fixing. But I can give it a look over anyway.
zh: 没什么需要修的。不过我还是可以看看。

#en: Ah, process finished. The Skydrop can be fabricated at your convenience.
zh: 啊，流程结束。你方便时就能制造这个空投。

#en: For now, I don't think there are any more we can extract. Perhaps later.
zh: 目前我想没有别的可提取了。也许以后吧。
